formulas.title: Line in Plane - Formula 1
formulas.latex: \text{The general equation of a line is }d:ax+by+c=0
formulas.description: The integral of a constant a is the (constant * x), plus the constant of integration C.
formulas.requirement: Calculate the primitive, then evaluate at x = 1 and C = 0.
